ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২) Three fair coins are tossed simultaneously. What is the probability of getting at least one head and one tail?

S = {HHH, HHT, HTT, THH, TTH, THT, HTH,TTT}

P(getting at least one head, one tail) = 6/8
                                                           = 3/4

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৪) A dice is thrown. What is the probability that the number shown on the dice is odd number ?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
When a dice is thrown once.
The total number of outcomes is 6 (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6)
Odd numbers = 3 (1, 3, 5)

Probability = No of Favorable Outcomes/Total no of Outcomes
P(Odd numbers) = 3/6
                           = 1/2

∴ The required probability is 1/2

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৭) In how may different ways can the letters of the word OPTICAL be arranged in such a way that the vowels always come together?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
The word 'OPTICAL' contains 7 different letters.
When the vowels OIA are always together, they can be supposed to form one letter.
Then, we have to arrange the letters PTCL (OIA).
Now, 5 letters can be arranged in 5! ways 
                                                   = 120 ways.
The vowels (OIA) can be arranged among themselves in 3! = 6 ways.

∴ Required number of ways = (120 x 6) = 720

 = {3, 6 , 9, 12, 15, 18, 5, 10, 20}

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৯) In how may different ways can the letters of the word EXTRA be arranged so that the vowels are never come together?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
The word 'EXTRA' contains 5 different letters.
The word EXTRA can be arranged in 5! ways = 120 ways

When the vowels EA are always together, they can be supposed to form one letter.
Then, we have to arrange the letters XTR(EA).
Now, 4 letters can be arranged in 4! ways 
                                                   = 24 ways.
The vowels (EA) can be arranged among themselves in 2! = 2 ways.
∴ The word EXTRA can be arranged in such a way that the vowels will be together = (24 x 2) =48


The letters of the words EXTRA be arranged so that the vowels are never together = (120 - 48) = 72 ways.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১০) A basket contains 2 red, 4 blue and 3 green marbles. If three marbles are picked up at random what is the probability that at least one is blue?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Total number of marbles = (2 + 4 + 3) = 9
Let E be the event of drawing 3 marbles such that none is blue.
Then, n (E) = number of ways of drawing 3 marbles out of 5 = 5C3 = 10
 n(S)=9C3
       =  84
∴P(E)=n(E)/n(S)
          = 10/84
          = 5/42

∴ Required probability
  = 1 - P(E)
  = 1 - (5/42)
  = (42 - 5)/42
  = 37/42

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১১) In how many ways can two men and five boys be seated in a linear arrangement so that all the men sit together?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Men can be treated as one group.
So, five boys and 1 group of men can be arranged in 6! ways.
Two men can be arranged in 2! ways.
Total no. of cases = 6! × 2!
                            = 720 × 2
                            = 1440 ways

∴ Required no. of ways =1440

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৪) Jahid rolled two dice together. What is the probability that first dice showed a multiple of 3 and the second dice showed an even number?

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৫) A box contains 2 white balls, 3 black balls and 4 red balls. In how many ways can 3 balls be drawn from the box, if at least one black ball is to be included in the draw?

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২১) At the end of a business conference, all 9 people present shake hands with each other once. How many handshakes will there be altogether?

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৬) A box contains 4 red, 5 green and 6 white balls. A ball is drawn at random from the box. What is the probability that the ball drawn is either red or white?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Total number of balls = (4 + 5 + 6) = 15
P(drawing a red ball or a white ball) = P(red) + P(white)
                                                          = (4/15) + (6/15)
                                                          = (4 + 6)/15
                                                          = 10/15
                                                          = 2/3
∴ The probability is 2/3.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৯) From a group of 7 men and 6 women, five persons are to be selected to form a committee so that at least 3 men are there on the committee. In how many ways can it be done ?
